verdict.rationale: Exemption and resale certificate management is a fair axis for a sales-tax product, but the evidence pack never mentions collecting, validating, storing, tracking expiry of, or automatically applying certificates. The zero-tax docs only say some transactions return zero tax with a taxability_reason, without tying this to certificates. The community note on VAT-number (VIES) validation concerns VAT IDs, not exemption or resale certificates, so it cannot be credited here.
